notes: ENVIRONMENT: chromium.launch() times out on this machine (wedged Metal compiler XPC service), so demo/validate/v4_themes.py could not be executed through Playwright. Every assertion in that file was executed instead as the equivalent DOM query against the running app in an already-open Chrome at http://127.0.0.1:8021, and the results are what this verdict records. Previous slices (v2_filter, v3_critique) recorded the same constraint the same way.

RE-VALIDATION, not the first run. The 23/24 verdict of 2026-08-10T00:52Z failed one check ('the link's offset matches the clock the row displays'). All 24 checks were re-run from scratch against the rebuilt frontend; 24/24 now pass. No check that passed before regressed.

BUNDLE PROVENANCE. The frontend is being rebuilt continuously by other agents, and Chrome will silently serve a cached index.html pointing at a superseded asset. A first pass in this session loaded a stale bundle (index-8JR9Y1NP.js) and reproduced the original defect exactly - two t params on all nine videos - which is a useful control but not the code under test. The verdict above was recorded against index-DOhbhTn4.js (frontend/dist built 19:17 local), fetched with cache:'reload' and confirmed as the asset the served index.html references. Note that grepping a bundle for 'time_continue' does NOT prove the fix is present: the pre-fix tree already contained that string in pipeline/graph.ts's local helper. The bundle was instead confirmed to contain zero occurrences of the old append idiom (`includes('?') ? '&' : '?'`), and behaviour was confirmed in the DOM.

THE NINE VIDEOS ARE THE RIGHT NINE. Independently enumerated from the persisted store (.yt-agent/chroma/chroma.sqlite3, distinct source_url values): 59 distinct source URLs, of which exactly 9 carry a seek param - by8wrrXW3So (t=51s), X4dEHRzBLmc (t=951s), omU3zR3K7-U (t=1s), cRz0BWkuwHg (t=19s), FU5_kpTAVDo (t=1871s), hgIonrdRTSE (t=141s), vpU9lZY69O4 (t=308s), fD0E57QYSPk (t=103s), 5N-okeDdIuI (t=2235s). No tenth was missed, and no stored URL uses 'start' or 'time_continue'. The builder's count of 9 is correct and the earlier verdict's estimate of 8 was low.

COVERAGE OF THE NINE ON THE THEMES SURFACE. Eight of the nine appear in at least one theme and were verified there. X4dEHRzBLmc ('Judge the Judge', an AI Engineer conference talk) is a member of no theme in the current 30-theme artifact, so it cannot be checked on V4's own surface; it was verified instead in RAG Pipeline -> Corpus & retrieval (34 chunk links, all single-t, all matching, pp preserved) and in the Chunk graph focus panel (t=1244s for 'open at 20:44').

THE VideoDetail t=91 BUG WAS REAL AND IS FIXED. HEAD's pipeline/VideoDetail.tsx:18 emitted `t=${seconds}` with no 's' suffix, so the acceptance script's WATCH regex ([?&]t=(\d+)s) would not have matched a single link on that panel - a second, independent defect the earlier verdict did not catch because it only walked the Themes tab. All 34 rendered links on the video detail panel now carry a suffixed t=<n>s.

SPOT-CHECKS AT THE OTHER CALL SITES THE SHARED HELPER TOUCHED. (a) pipeline/VideoDetail.tsx - X4dEHRzBLmc opened: 34 links, 0 with more than one t, 0 missing the 's' suffix, 0 whose offset disagrees with the label, and the pp=ygUObGxtIGFzIGEganVkZ2U%3D blob survives byte-for-byte (the %3D is not re-encoded, confirming the string-editing approach over URL/URLSearchParams). (b) pipeline/ChunkGraphView.tsx - 151 nodes clicked covering 36 distinct videos; 6 of the 9 seek-param videos surfaced (by8wrrXW3So 22:41->1361s, X4dEHRzBLmc 20:44->1244s, fD0E57QYSPk 0:52->52s, FU5_kpTAVDo 13:59->839s, omU3zR3K7-U 0:00->0s, vpU9lZY69O4 20:08->1208s), all single-t and all matching. No regression from dropping graph.ts's local chunkTimestampUrl. (c) pipeline/KnowledgeGraphView.tsx COULD NOT be exercised: /api/graph/knowledge returns HTTP 503 in this environment (no Neo4j), so the view renders only the error card and emits no kg-claimlink. Its call site was reviewed in source and its 7 unit tests pass, but this verdict carries no rendered evidence for it.

SUPPORTING (not a substitute for the DOM evidence above): vitest over the five affected files passes 78/78 - answers/render.test.ts 33, pipeline/graph.test.ts 14, ThemesView.test.tsx 9, KnowledgeGraphView.test.tsx 7, ChunkGraphView.test.tsx 15. `npm run build` still fails at tsc -b on src/experiments/CritiquePanel.test.tsx, which is another agent's in-flight file and unrelated to V4; `npx vite build` succeeds.
No uncaught frontend errors were observed in the console during the walk.

'.th-chunkpreview' is deliberately white-space: nowrap and is excluded from the clipping probe: it is a fixed-length collapsed excerpt whose full text is one click away in .th-chunkbody. That is the only nowrap field in the theme CSS and the comment at styles.ts:135 says so explicitly.

Layout width was varied by constraining .app rather than by resizing the window (the extension's resize does not change innerWidth, which stayed at 1158px in this session). Clipping was measured at layout widths 1440, 1000 and 820px - the last is below the 900px media-query breakpoint where .th-layout collapses to one column - plus the native 1158px.

The corpus has grown to 59 videos / 1460 chunks since the previous verdict, but the themes artifact is still the 53-video / 1329-chunk build, which is what the list header states. That is a staleness question for the theme build, not a V4 frontend defect, and is outside the 24 checks.
